title: Kazakhstan Company Profile
description: Country-specific company profile for Kazakhstan. The universal key is the 12-digit BIN (Business Identification Number). The authoritative OPEN register is the data.egov.kz dataset gbd_ul (State Database of Legal Entities) — BIN, name (RU/KZ), registration date, legal address, OKED activity, director name — served via the data.egov.kz API but gated by a FREE API key (registration; verified 403 without a key). The State Revenue Committee (KGD) adds tax/VAT status by BIN/IIN (browser-public search + published lists). Listed companies come from the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) by ISIN (KZ...). Language Russian (+ Kazakh); currency KZT; activity classified by OKED. The director name (gbd_ul) and individual taxpayers (KGD) are personal data — redact. No registry per-company values were captured (API key not obtained).

bin.description: 12-digit Business Identification Number — registration number, tax id, and universal join key.

legal_name.description: Legal-entity name (RU/KZ). gbd_ul authoritative; KGD taxpayer_name as alt.

taxpayer_status.description: KGD taxpayer status (active/inactive/pseudo-enterprise/debtor) — TAX status, not registration status.

officers.description: Director (gbd_ul). PERSONAL DATA (Law on Personal Data) — REDACT. API-key-gated.

listing.description: Present only for KASE-listed companies (browser-public SPA).
